title: STRENGTH + ENDURANCE · HINGE + RINGS
emphasis: Strength first, then a comfortable steady finish. Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve.

ignition.name: Movement prep
ignition.prescription: 2 min easy rope or walk; 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.
ignition.home: 2 min easy rope or walk; 2 min hips/ankles/shoulders; 2 min unloaded rehearsal of today’s lifts.

deposits.title: TRAP BAR DEADLIFT

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 3 sets of 5; leave 3 good reps. Use a repeatable load and record it. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: 3 sets of 5; leave 3 good reps. Use a repeatable load and record it. Demo unavailable.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: RING ROW + PUSH-UP

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up
exercises.cue: Repeat the movement with clean form; no progression this exposure.
exercises.prescription: 6 clean reps; adjust leverage to leave 3 good reps. Hold this setup before increasing difficulty.
exercises.home: 6 clean reps; adjust leverage to leave 3 good reps. Hold this setup before increasing difficulty.

deposits.effort: Set rings once at a height that allows both movements. Adjust foot position for difficulty.
deposits.label: B

deposits.title: SUITCASE CARRY

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.prescription: 30 sec/side with a kettlebell or dumbbell. Walk tall without leaning.
exercises.home: 30 sec/side with a kettlebell or dumbbell. Walk tall without leaning.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: C

deposits.title: STEADY ENDURANCE FINISH

exercises.name: Steady treadmill or outdoor walk
exercises.cue: Keep a pace that lets you speak complete sentences.
exercises.prescription: 10 min easy continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.
exercises.home: 10 min easy continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.

deposits.effort: 10 min at a comfortable conversational pace; smooth breathing, not an all-out finisher.
deposits.label: D

deposits.title: MOBILITY

exercises.name: Ankle rocks + calf mobility
exercises.cue: Move slowly in a comfortable range. No forcing or bouncing.
exercises.prescription: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Alternate gentle knee-to-wall ankle rocks and a comfortable standing calf stretch. Split the allotted time equally between movements and sides; heel stays down. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Comfortable active range; stop anything painful. No forced stretching.
deposits.label: E

levels.bonus: Optional brisk walk; dummy lab separate

weekSummary: This week: Mon strength A · Tue strength B + steady finish · Wed endurance · Thu endurance · Fri strength C · Sat boxing · Sun recovery

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · SINGLE-LEG POSITION CHECK
martialSupplement.home: Study one familiar single-leg entry slowly. Pause at contact to check posture and connection; do not drive or finish forcefully into the dummy. Up to 3 slow reps/side. Focus: Where can posture or connection be kept more consistent?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
